description: This PHP class defines the LeavePeriodModel, which implements the Normalizable interface and uses traits to facilitate serialization of LeavePeriod DTO objects within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. It sets entity, filters, and attribute names for serialization purposes.

classes.name: LeavePeriodModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing LeavePeriod objects, implementing normalization features for API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with a LeavePeriod entity, and sets serialization filters and attribute mappings.
